meta.anchor_scaling: alpha = 1.00 measured on the mass ladder (step 083) -- m_req(a9) = 6.9*d_of/drot_6.9(a9)
meta.eph_bound: 5-sigma tidal detection line, sigma_M = 0.22 M_earth (d/400 AU)^3 (Gomes, Murray, Gomes, Holman & Bernstein 2023, PSJ 4:66, median over sky)
meta.planetY_box: SCT25 warp-producing range ~0.06-1 M_earth, a=100-200 AU, i>~10 deg

anti_a100.note: frac_within_planetY_box: share of in-cap comets whose required mass falls inside the SCT25 0.06-1 M_earth box; frac_below_eph_bound: share whose required mass would escape the Gomes+23 5-sigma tidal detection line
